lines: d26: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Milton Longo is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d26: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d26: 🕯️ Milton is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d26: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d26: 🕯️ Milton Longo is dead — the night. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d26: What Milton kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d26: "Milton's gone." Catalina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Milton." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d26: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Woo-jin blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d26: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d26: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d26: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d26: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d26: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d26: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d26: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Milton Longo, 26 days. The mantle passes to Woo-jin Eom.
d26: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Woo-jin Eom, 23 — a journalist. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Bird Whisperer.
